title: Janet Fielding oral history
description: An oral history interview with Australian born actor Janet Fielding by ABC radio presenter Spencer Howson. Janet Fielding discusses growing up in Brisbane, her acting career, moving to London, portraying a Queenslander in Doctor Who, life in the UK.
